result:
Both waits are armed. Let me summarize where things stand while they run.

**PR [#166](https://github.com/jreinach-alt/hakuX/pull/166)** — draft, `harness` labelled, board request posted as a comment.

**What is built:**
- `desktop_channel.sh serve` — registers `lanes/desktop` on the handheld protocol (pid + `kill -0`), re-asserts every tick, releases only its own pid, traps `TERM` as well as `EXIT` because systemd stops with `SIGTERM`. It claims **only** an explicit desktop pin (equality with `desktop`, never an empty affinity answer — the handheld's "free, anyone may take it"), scores nothing, and writes `runs: []` so `ab_compare.py` keeps refusing it.
- `HAKUX_RENDERER` read out of the request's existing `env` list, so a GL/Vulkan A/B needs no change to `request.sh` (`lane.toolsmith`'s), plus `[display.quality] surface_scale = 1` pinned in `cmd_run`'s `xemu.toml` — the third branch of `surface_download_to_buffer()` asserts `pitch >= width*bpp` and is reachable only from a *scaled desktop GL* run.
- `systemd/hakux-desktop.service` with the explicit `Environment=PATH=` carrying `~/.local/bin`, and one line in `install-host.sh` to actually **enable** it — the loop installed units and enabled a named list that omitted this one.
- `selftest.d/56-desktop-worker.sh` — 28 checks, four mutants and a control, each mutant verified to differ from the real file before it runs.

**Measured so far:** `preflight.sh` passes with no flags. `selftest.sh` = 544 passed / 10 failed against a master baseline of 516 / 10 — byte-for-byte the same ten, all `86-fold-regressed.sh` (`lane.selftest86`'s, currently running on this host). 516 + 28 = 544, so all 28 new checks pass.

**Two things I did not do and said why, in the PR body and NOTES:** `arms.sh` is untouched (the routing patch is written out with line anchors — and flagged as only *half* a change, since `ab_compare.py`'s `register()` has no flag that can write the `device` field it keys on), and the two `arms/skipped/` markers are not deleted, because `undersized-pitch-swizzle-layout.json` still needs bare-sha refs and an `only_tests` disc before it could run.

Two open waits: the local selftest re-run on the final code, and CI. I'll mark the PR ready once CI settles — noting the `selftest` check itself will be red for the `86-fold-regressed.sh` reason above, which is not foldable ahead of `lane.selftest86`'s fix.
